follows.note: XM3's windows, truth, clusters, leads and scorer; new arms flown as the console flies FFM-1, with no fit

build.note: the modules commit (XM3's) and each module's wasm SHA-256; every wasm is read with git show at that commit, never from a working tree

xm.code: XM's lib/truth.mjs, lib/weather.mjs, lib/public.mjs, lib/sds.mjs and lib/modules.mjs are imported unchanged; experiments/xp-atmosphere-merit must equal the commit (git diff) for every run
xm.dcl: XM's cached $DCL answers (<xm store>/dcl/<issue ms>.json), read only through XM3's cachedDcl; a missing one is an error, never computed here

xm3.rows: XM3's stored rows, condition O (<xm3 store>/rows/O.s*.jsonl, the first unflagged row per key), read only, their digest checked against its committed table's; every rerun P, bins, condition O record and $DCL answer must equal them
xm3.code: XM3's lib/ffm.mjs driverRows and cachedDcl imported unchanged; experiments/ffm-atmosphere-xm3 must equal the commit (git diff) for every run

table.read: git show <commit>:<path>, SHA-256 checked; its F3/F2, F2/P and F3/P cells are reported beside K2/K1, K1/P and K2/P

period.cutoff: 00:00 UTC of every day of the period
period.why: XM's period: C2 holds out every calibration object from cutoff 2026-06-01 on (integrity cut 2)

K1.label: FFM-1 as flown, NRLMSISE-00 alone, rows L

K2.label: K1 with the $DCL read as the console reads it

K3.label: K2 with another date's record, its node times moved onto this cutoff

baseline.P: XM's P: the newest public Space-Track set at the cutoff under the console's SGP4, rerun with XM's code at its commit in every window and required equal to XM3's stored row

path.note: the shard worker's calls in order (OrbPro propagator.ffm/ffmFrameWorker.js:309-426): plugin_init, plugin_configure_catalog, plugin_set_grid_stagger(1), plugin_set_ephemeris_retention(0.02), plugin_init_states_ecef, plugin_set_visibility_mask; plugin_ensure_coverage before each read; the read is plugin_eval_catalog_states_gcrf; records framed as OrbPro catalogConfiguration.js frames them
path.failure: a refused configuration, a profile other than FFM-1, a refused or failed coverage call, a state the module leaves zero, a non-finite state or an invalid seed fails the arm in every bin of the window (rule 3), never dropped

weather.O: XM's rowsO from cutoff - 72 h - 3 d with XM3's driverRows through D0 + 8: GFZ observed, then the RSGA in force, the last predicted day held; one trailing 81-day mean on every row. Report only
weather.L: rows O with F107_OBS_CENTER81 by the lane's rule (data-source/space-weather/src/space_weather.cpp:31-32): the mean over the day and 40 days each side, over the as-issued series: GFZ observed before the rows' first day, the rows' own daily values, their last value held past their last day; a day with no value is skipped. Causal. The verdict's rows (coordinator's ruling, 2026-10-31, before any score)
weather.H: rows O with F107_OBS_CENTER81 the same mean over GFZ's file retrieved 2026-10-09. Not causal; report only: the other bound of what a 45-day forecast could give
weather.fields: SDS SPW rows (DATE, F107_OBS, F107_OBS_CENTER81, AP_AVG) in one PRW SPACE_WEATHER table

record.read: the newest record issued at 00:00 UTC of a day at or before the cutoff that was not refused (XM's cache)

moved.rule: Q is D0 + 20 d when that is in the period, else D0 - 20 d; the record read at Q with its node times moved by D0 - Q, values unchanged

record.framing: XM's cache holds the module's bytes without a size prefix; the catalog path takes the published size-prefixed form; each record is re-framed by the SDS bindings with every field equal (checked)

earthOrientation.rows: its earth_orientation_finals rows (IERS finals.all.iau2000.txt retrieved 2026-10-09, parsed by data-source/eop-parser; B1 amendments A1 and A2); B1's rule takes them for every arc before 2026-07-15 (its saved rows begin at MJD 61236), as C2's fits of these objects took them
earthOrientation.slice: the rows with MJD in [MJD(D0 - 2 d) - 1, MJD(D0 + 9 d) + 1], one PRW EARTH_ORIENTATION
earthOrientation.disclosure: final values over the forecast horizon, not the predictions issued at the cutoff; the effect at 7 days is meters against errors of kilometers; P and the X arms use no Earth orientation

outOfScope.TerraSAR-X 31698: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.Sentinel-1D 66315: C2 holds it out by object (cut 1)
outOfScope.ISS 25544: C2 holds the ISS out for 2025-01-01..2026-10-31 (cut 3)
outOfScope.laser-ranged spheres: C2's type-L hold-out and after 2026-06-01 (cuts 2 and 4)

integrity.rule: C2's held-out objects are out entirely
integrity.applied: XM's groups P and S1 only: no C2 held-out object

integrity.rule: C2's calibration objects: no cutoff on or after 2026-06-01
GPCV P0: Swarm and GRACE-FO truth read only in 2025-12-28..2026-06-08
integrity.applied: as XM; the smoke test's arc (Swarm A, cutoff 2025-12-31) lies inside it

integrity.rule: never read: C2 held-out row files, B2 part 1a and part 5 files, propagator-catalog-census results, operator-capture cycle content
integrity.applied: no step reads them; C2's seeds-R1R2.json is a calibration-time seed file from published area and mass

integrity.rule: never read: C3-small's rows, and nothing from the internal open-DCA diagnosis enters a commit
integrity.applied: no step reads C3-small rows or the diagnosis folder

scoring.grid: XM's: the truth's epochs in (cutoff, cutoff + 7 d] whose offset from the first of them is a whole multiple of 300 s
scoring.bin: lead day k: (cutoff + (k - 1) d, cutoff + k d]
scoring.binRule: a bin enters when the truth holds at least 260 of its 288 grid epochs (90 %), decided by the truth alone
scoring.metric: e: the 3D RMS position error of the bin (km) in the truth's RTN axes (analysis/gp-error-model pair_statistics, XM's scorer); the along-track RMS beside it
scoring.frames: K arms are GCRF as propagator/ffm returns them; P goes TEME to GCRF by foundation/frames as in XM; every arm is scored against the same GCRF truth at the same epochs
scoring.nonFinite: an arm with a non-finite state at a scored epoch fails

statistics.pairs: per group, condition, contrast and lead: the windows whose bin entered and whose reference arm was attempted
statistics.d: ln(e_arm / e_ref); arm failed: +Infinity (its loss, never dropped); else reference failed: -Infinity
statistics.p95: ln(p95 of e_arm / p95 of e_ref), a failed arm's e = +Infinity

bootstrap.unit: orbit group x ISO week of the cutoff

statistics.nan: a NaN statistic counts as +Infinity (against the arm)

windows.rule: each K cell pairs the windows of XM3's F2 against P cell: windows out of condition O (cutoff 2026-01-01) and S1's windows below XM3's arc coverage (read from XM3's stored row) stay out, counted; P is rerun in every registered window

verdict.rule: an arm beats its reference in a group only if every lead cell meets all three: (1) the 95 % interval of the median d lies wholly below 0; (2) the upper bound of the 95 % interval of ln(p95_arm / p95_ref) is below ln 1.10; (3) the arm fails on at most 1 % of the pairs
verdict.reading: K2 against K1, per lead: the 95 % interval of the median d wholly below 0 is a gain at that lead, wholly above 0 is harm, holding 0 is no detectable effect
verdict.decides: the coordinator takes K2 against K1 to the owner as the evidence for keeping or removing the DCA from FFM-1; XM4 decides nothing by itself

check.rule: each pinned window re-run and every stored number compared exactly; the table rebuilt from the stored rows equal to the committed table.json byte for byte
check.why: XM3's first two windows, and Swarm B 2026-04-09, where K2 flies the record of 04-08 held

smoke.window: XM3's smoke window: Swarm A 39452, cutoff 2025-12-31, outside the period, rows of condition M, the $DCL issued 2026-01-01T00:00Z; no truth after its cutoff, nothing scored
